message: NG02952: The NgOptimizedImage directive has detected that `sizes` was set to a string including pixel values. For automatic `srcset` generation, `sizes` must only include responsive values, such as `sizes="50vw"` or `sizes="(min-width: 768px) 50vw, 100vw"`. To fix this, modify the `sizes` attribute, or provide your own `ngSrcset` value directly.
